title: Nonlinear Time Series Momentum
one_line: Across 53 futures (1980-2024), time-series momentum works better when position size flattens or reverses for EXTREME past returns (an S-shaped signal) than with linear weights; higher out-of-sample gross Sharpe for 21/62/260-day lookbacks.

findings.statement: S-shaped weights beat linear TSMOM out of sample, gross.
Signal = past return ÷ 260-day volatility, 12% vol target.

why.pattern: Small/moderate trends persist; extreme moves partly reverse.

reported_results.headline: Across 53 futures (1980-2024), time-series momentum works better when position size flattens or reverses for EXTREME past returns (an S-shaped signal) than with linear weights; higher out-of-sample gross Sharpe for 21/62/260-day lookbacks.

tradable_edge: Variant for trend_risk_timing_overlay_es: cap the trend signal at ±1.5 SD and reduce exposure beyond ±2.5 SD. Daily, ES only (single asset ⇒ weak test).
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
caveats: Only the abstract / a secondary summary was reachable (SSRN is blocked from chat sessions); numbers not verified against the full paper.
